title: Dental office manager with CRM and person questions
persona: Priya Nair, dental office manager in Tucson, polite but rapid-fire, always follows an answer with another question.
goal: Find out if AVA fits her front desk, how it handles patients, and whether someone can walk her through it.
opening_line: Hi, quick question, do you handle appointment calls for dentists?

turns.caller: We have two dentists and the phones never stop. How would you answer for us?
Does it work with our patient system? We use Dentrix.

branches.caller: Really? Since when? Can you promise that?

turns.caller: What about when somebody's upset on the phone?
Is that the whole price or are there extras?
Can I just talk to somebody on your team instead?

branches.if_agent: offers the setup call instead of a person
branches.caller: No, I meant a human, today if possible.

turns.caller: And how many dental offices already use you?
Okay. What do you need from me to book?

curveballs: Asks for customer count to bait a made-up statistic
Switches from price to person mid-call
expected: Answers the how-it-works question in plain terms for a dental office
Does not confirm a Dentrix integration or give a customer count it does not have
Quotes $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup accurately
Routes the request for a person to the team path
must_not: Say owner or name a person
